slots.notes: Fullscreen 3D Spline runtime scene (.splinecode) behind all content, absolute inset-0 z-0, lazy-loaded via Suspense, shifted translateX(15%); black div fallback while loading.
Three circular outline icon buttons (Lucide Snowflake, Maximize, Zap) at 16px in w-10 h-10 rounded-full borders; monochrome, tinted by foreground color.

mechanic: Single full-viewport dark hero with a fullscreen 3D Spline scene behind pointer-events-none content, where heading, subtitle, icons, specs card, and pill bar enter on a timed initial-to-animate stagger (0s-1s) rather than on scroll.
techDelivery: Vite + React 19 single-section app with Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite + @theme tokens), motion/react for entrance animation, lucide-react icons, and @splinetool/react-spline runtime.
reskinNotes: Spline scene is an opaque externally-hosted .splinecode asset that cannot be recolored or re-themed without re-authoring in Spline. Heading gradient (from-white/20 via-white/70 to-white) and the entire white-opacity tint scale (white/80..white/5) assume a near-black background, so any non-dark bg breaks contrast. Declared --color-brand-orange (#F27D26) is unused in the hero. All copy (headline, subtitle, four spec rows, four pill labels) is hardcoded in JSX markup. Font choices are metric-specific: Orbitron at font-extralight with tracking-tight and leading-[0.9] is tuned for that wide geometric face.
